description.value: The Packing House Pub has been a Kelowna institution since 1977, tucked off Highway 97 in an industrial area on Finns Road and self-described as 'one of Kelowna's oldest and most notorious establishments.' It leans into its working-class roots with large portions of homemade comfort food, ice-cold beer, and staff who remember regulars by name. A unique draw is the attached bowling alley, making it an unexpectedly fun stop for cyclists wanting more than just a meal.

enrichment_extras.notes: The pub has an attached bowling alley (noted in customer reviews and social media), which may add appeal as a rest stop. Part of the multi-venue Woodsman Group, which also operates Woody's Pub (Lake Country), The Winston Pub (Vernon), and Black Pine Social (SilverStar).
